title: Obsidian for stone tools
text: Obsidian from the Coso Volcanic Field was heavily exploited by the Native American Coso People between about 3,000 and 1,000 years ago. Geochemists have identified four subsources of the glass, including one at Sugarloaf and one at Joshua Ridge.

s1.title: Coso Volcanic Field
s1.quote: Obsidian from the Coso Volcanic Fields was heavily exploited by Native American Coso People ... between approximately 3000 and 1000 years ago ... Four geochemical subsources were identified: Sugarloaf, West Sugarloaf, Joshua Ridge, and West Cactus Peak
